record: R27 measure-now over stored dossier runs
scope: six run directories of redis/redis at 498ecd0d; run-*.agents and run-*.sessions never opened; no provider, no dossier or consent command

headlines.a: cited-path mean pairwise Jaccard 0.613 (14 of 39 paths in every run); claim level strict 0.317 (loose 0.787); intro word Jaccard 0.26, Pole label words 0.29 over 3 runs with Poles
headlines.b: 545 supported-claim clusters pooled; per-run share 0.136-0.508; 396 in one run only, 10 in all six; inventory 185 clusters, per-run share 0.249-0.486
headlines.c: overlap-or-named pre-check recall 0.834 (151/181), noise 12 represented + 21 justified; overlap-only recall 0.923 noise 17+36
headlines.d: 0 of 16 later fidelity deliveries repeat the previous packet; unchanged blocks are 0.322 of later block bytes but 0.043 of packet bytes; item-level unchanged (blocks, spans, inventory, schema, criteria) 0.301 of canonical bytes
headlines.e: 5 of 23 consecutive verdict pairs share a packet, all same-session resubmissions after a refused check; readiness agrees 5/5; independent re-review of identical bytes: none stored (Unknown)
headlines.f: fidelity round median 5.13 min over 22 rounds; design 5.84 min over 7; review rounds 0.565 of wall time; observable operator actions 7-7 per run (a floor)
headlines.g: 1440x900: thesis on first screen 2/5, figure top 3/5, horizontal scroll 0/5; 390x844: thesis on first screen 0/5, figure top 0/5, horizontal scroll 5/5

a_author_variance.label: Observed

predicates.block: any dict under introduction, sections, diagrams, deepDives or unresolved with a non-empty citations list whose items carry a path (understanding record excluded)
predicates.citedPaths: set of citation path values over those blocks
predicates.loose: block X in run A is matched in run B if some cited span of X and some cited span of any block in B share a path and their closed line ranges intersect
predicates.strict: block X in run A is matched in run B if some block in B has a cited (path,line) set with Jaccard >= 0.5 against X
predicates.pairs: mean over the 15 unordered run pairs (Jaccard) or 30 ordered pairs (share matched)

a_author_variance.denominator: 6 runs; blocks per run in runs[*].blocks
a_author_variance.caveat: Runs used brief versions v1 to v7 and draft schemas v2 to v4, so variance mixes author variance with brief and schema change; the commit is fixed (498ecd0d) for all six.

b_pooled_ceiling.label: Observed (counts); Inferred (that the union approximates a depth ceiling)

predicates.supportedClaim: a block (mlib.blocks) of the draft inside the packet of the run's last fidelity verdict whose blockSupport verdict is 'supported' and which cites at least one line range
predicates.sameClaim: blocks from different runs join a cluster when their cited (path,line) sets have Jaccard >= 0.5 (union-find, transitive)
predicates.sameEntry: inventory entries from different runs (last inventory revision) join when kinds are equal and cited (path,line) Jaccard >= 0.5; an entry with no line citation is its own cluster
predicates.share: clusters containing at least one item from the run / all clusters

c_r4_replay.label: Observed

predicates.firstVerdict: the lowest-numbered fidelity verdict file whose steps.jsonl review-check row (same number) has outcome 'validated'
predicates.overlap: some citation of the entry shares a path with, and has an intersecting closed line range with, some citation of any draft block (mlib.blocks over the packet draft)
predicates.samePath: some citation path of the entry equals some cited path of any draft block
predicates.named: some citation path of the entry occurs as a substring of the text/statement of any draft block
predicates.listed: the pre-check lists an entry when the variant predicate for represented is false; variants overlapOrNamed (the R4 form), overlapOnly, samePathOrNamed

c_r4_replay.denominator: entries in the inventory carried by each first fidelity packet (entriesTotal); recall over reviewer-unsupported entries

d_r5_replay.label: Observed

predicates.delivery: steps.jsonl rows with step 'session-prompt', outcome 'delivered' and the kind; packet read from reviews/<kind>-packet-<packetSha256>/packet.json
predicates.sameDigest: a delivery's packetSha256 equals the previous delivery's of the same kind in the same run
predicates.unchangedBlock: a block (mlib.blocks over packet.draft.document) whose id is present in the previous packet with an equal canonical-JSON sha256 of the block minus its children
predicates.unchangedSpan: an item of packet.spans whose id is present in the previous packet with equal canonical-JSON sha256
predicates.unchangedInventory: packet.inventory.document canonical-JSON sha256 equal to the previous packet
predicates.bytes: packet.json file bytes; block, span and inventory bytes are compact canonical JSON (an approximation of their share of the file)

d_r5_replay.denominator: deliveries per kind across the six runs (pooled.*.deliveries); later = all but the first delivery of a run

e_reviewer_consistency.label: Observed

predicates.pair: consecutive verdict files N and N+1 of one kind in one run (reviews/<kind>-verdict-N.json) with equal packetSha256
predicates.findingSet: set of (severity, subject, target) triples; Jaccard between the two verdicts
predicates.agreement: share of block ids (entry ids) present in both verdicts with an equal blockSupport verdict (coverage disposition)
predicates.reviewCheckOutcome: steps.jsonl review-check row whose number equals the verdict file number

e_reviewer_consistency.denominator: consecutiveVerdictPairsExamined pairs across six runs and two kinds; zero consecutive deliveries had equal digests (figure d), so equal-packet pairs are re-submissions to the same delivery

f_stage_time_and_operator_actions.label: Observed (times, records); Inferred (operator-action total is a floor: preflight, clone agreement, init and any consent steps leave no step record)

predicates.round: a steps.jsonl session-prompt row with outcome 'delivered'; it ends at the next review-check row of the same kind with outcome 'validated'; refused review-check rows in between are counted
predicates.sessionsStarted: distinct (role, kind, session) over await rows: each is a terminal the operator started
predicates.clarificationsAnswered: length of clarifications in the last draft revision
predicates.usageFiguresGivenAtClose: close row carries a usage value other than null/'not-recorded'/{}
predicates.configurationAnswer: one run-configuration answer per run (SKILL.md step 3), not recorded in steps

f_stage_time_and_operator_actions.denominator: 6 runs; rounds counted per kind in reviewRounds

g_first_screen.label: Observed

predicates.h1: first h1 inside main; top in document px; lines = rendered height / computed line-height
predicates.thesis: first p after the h1 in document order with at least 12 whitespace-separated words
predicates.figure: figure elements inside main that contain an svg
predicates.firstScreen: document y < declared viewport height (900 or 844), scroll at top; figureFullyAboveFoldPx = viewport height minus figure top (how much of the figure shows)
predicates.render: local headless Chrome via pursuit/audit/tools/cdp.mjs, light scheme; 390 run with MOBILE=1 emulation; no provider, no network

g_first_screen.denominator: 5 reading pages (index, three Poles, one deep dive) x 2 viewports
